summary: Money reserved for a particular race stays available when the committee endorses nobody in it.
realLife: Murphy reported that money designated for a Burien council race remained available because the 34th Democrats had endorsed no candidate for that seat.
inGame: needs: the budget allocation, endorsement result and any later spending vote.

turns.what: The treasurer carries the amount forward.
turns.pulledBy: The committee makes no new spending decision.
turns.writesBack: No candidate receives money by default.

turns.pulledBy: Members approve a later use of the available money.
